blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Philippine Anti-Corruption Czar (PACC), a civil society watchdog, filed a complaint-affidavit before the Office of the Ombudsman on Thursday in connection with the P600-million Naga City Convention Center. PACC National Chairman Dr. Louie Ceniza said they lodged the complaint to urge the Ombudsman to investigate the unfinished project in Brgy. Carolina. He said that the convention center has a multi-year funding of approximately P600 million. However, the P98-million first phase of the construction remained stalled and did not move forward despite the project’s target completion date of 2026, he said. “Alam nyo yung Naga City Convention Center […]...
